method:
My own servers: main api 8110 (site 4110), control api 8111 (site 4111), started with up.sh and dropped at the end (databases pt5_main_8110, pt5_control_8111). Folder: /home/user/pt5/verify/death.

How the tables were built:
- lib.js is a copy of v8401_lib.js with the port, database, state file, shots folder and seeding key set by TREE=main|control. It also starts the X-Forwarded-For counter at a random point, so reruns do not hit the sign-up limit.
- setup.js builds three sealed tables over the API and seals them in SQL (is_finalized, roster_finalized, pools set):
  - S 'The Sealed Hours': Iris Vane (Slink, Death Defy), Bram Holt and Cass Reed (Journalists), at 4/4/4.
  - D 'The Dying Hours': Ada, Dev and Eve, at 4/4/4.
  - R 'The Return Hours': Mara and Noor, at 3/3/3.

How the steps were driven:
- Marks are dealt with take_mark {mark_type, character_id, is_from_enemy} from a Node socket on the campaign code (the Lightkeeper's channel). Open it before the Lightkeeper's browser desk, then close it, so the browser desk is not superseded. Use is_from_enemy:true to get a Death Defy hold (88.1).
- A second browser on the same character takes the desk over. Close it and reload the first browser before acting there.
- To send a frame as the page's own socket, use seat.sockets[n].server.send(...) through the routeWebSocket proxy. s72c.js uses this for edit_sheet.
- The death dialog ('Stay and look at the sheet') must be dismissed before anything on a dead desk can be clicked.
- Read the Lightkeeper's roster card from button[aria-label="Open <name>'s investigator sheet"] (card.js). Text matching on 'No.' is fragile, because the log also holds the name in hidden truncated lines.
- Removing a stored report needs (backstory_answers::jsonb #- '{reports,<id>}')::json, because the column is json.

Scripts:
- s72.js: #72 and 88.8, with a restart, a reload, another device and recording. Run with DEV=laptop or phone.
- s72b.js: sign out and back in.
- s72c.js: the Edit sheet scar.
- s73.js: #73 live on four desks, then #76 desk and server.
- s82.js: 88.1 with a restart, then #82.
- s77.js: #77, 88.7 and #84, with browser A watching the approval and fresh browser B on phone.
- nb.js: replacement after a death; leave across End Assignment.
- p*.js: probes. m44.js: touch sizes.

Results are in r*.json and screenshots in shots/. Not separately rechecked: the earlier '2 Bleed marks held' nit, and a death before the seal.

method: My folder is /home/user/pt5/verify/restarts. lib.js is a copy of ../death/lib.js on ports 8120/4120 (main) and 8121/4121 (control), picked with TREE=main|control. I added to it: seat.dropIn(msg) to drop chosen server frames (I held back activity_history to force a real refused keep after a restart); seat.holdOut(msg) to hold one outgoing frame type while pings flow (a Non-Combatant answer that reaches the server after its 120 s window; do not stall the whole socket, or the heartbeat replaces it); restart(); texts(); buttons(). setup.js builds the tables over the API on each tree: sealed campaign S with Iris (Death Defy), Bram (Journalist, gilded Survey and Focus), Finn (Doctor, Non-Combatant), Joss (Behind Me), Tam (Adrenaline Rush) and Cass (Premonitions); unsealed campaign J for join requests (Olive and Pip of player px). For #87 roll modifications I gave Finn 'Learn from My Mistakes' in SQL (Use, Skip and a drive picker after a result of 3 or less), then set Non-Combatant back. Scripts by item: g78 (#78, plus 88.u17 and 88.5 measures; INT=1 leaves the drive short), gdice (88.5, 88.u17, D10), g87 (#87 Use/Skip), g79 and g79b (#79 reload, full drive, restart, late answer), g80 and g80b (#80 socket and double press), g81 and g81b (#81, and the roster-card seam), g83 (#83), g86 and g86b (#86, 88.u8, 88.u26), gu8 (88.u8 phone), g11 and g11b (88.u11), grush (Rush after a restart), g78b (End Assignment while offline), gorder (connect frame order). Note: Spend asks for a second press (88.i3), so hold the elementHandle and click it twice. On a phone, the dice sheet opens from the 'Dice and log' button. The control's offer pickers read NER/CUN/INT. Servers are stopped and both databases (pt5_main_8120, pt5_control_8121) are dropped. Screenshots are in shots/ (111 files); I looked at every one I cite. Not checked: the ally select pickers' sizes, the #79 control 'recovered 1' log by a real click, and 4401 sign-out.
praise: #78: the restart wording is exact and calm in both cases ('That roll was lost when the server restarted. Roll again.' and 'The server restarted, so this roll can no longer be burned or changed.'), and a plain socket drop never gets a false restart line, End Assignment while offline included.
#86: the Burn open stamp follows the server's truth across a reload, a second tab, a burn, a restart and a roller with no resistance left, and its i is one plain sentence.
#80: the refusal sits after the roll_id replay, so a resent held roll is still answered with the same dice; the desk also disables Roll and a double press sends one roll.
